diseases.recommended_treatment: Deploy yellow sticky traps (10-12 per acre). If ETL exceeded (>5 adults/leaf), apply recommended insect growth regulator (IGR).
diseases.safe_dosage: 200-250 ml per acre in 100 liters of water
diseases.safety_precautions: Spray during early morning or late afternoon. Wear protective masks and gloves. Do not exceed recommended concentrations.
diseases.source: Agriculture Department Punjab & PlantVillage Pest Index

diseases.disease_name: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus - CLCuV (کپاس کا پتہ مروڑ وائرس)
diseases.recommended_treatment: Control whitefly vector promptly. Uproot heavily infected plants. Apply balanced nutrition (Zinc and Boron foliar spray) to boost resistance.
diseases.safe_chemical: No direct viricide exists. Vector control with Flonicamid 50 WG.
diseases.safe_dosage: 60-80 grams per acre in 100 liters water
diseases.safety_precautions: Never apply random chemicals for viral diseases. Target the whitefly vector only.

diseases.recommended_treatment: Install sex pheromone traps (8 traps/acre). Shred crop residue. Apply bio-pesticide or approved systemic spray.
diseases.safe_chemical: Spinetoram 11.7 SC or Emamectin Benzoate 1.9 EC
diseases.safe_dosage: 80-100 ml per acre in 100-120 liters water
diseases.safety_precautions: Rotate chemical modes of action to prevent resistance. Toxic to aquatic organisms.
diseases.source: Pest Warning & Quality Control of Pesticides Punjab

symptoms: powder on fingers when touching leaf
diseases.recommended_treatment: Apply triazole fungicide immediately upon initial detection before it spreads across field.
diseases.safe_dosage: 200-250 ml per acre in 100-120 liters water
diseases.safety_precautions: Do not spray within 30 days of harvest. Ensure complete foliage coverage.

symptoms: small green or black insects on ears
diseases.recommended_treatment: Conserve natural predators (ladybird beetles). If ETL exceeded (>15 aphids/spike before dough stage), apply safe insecticide.
diseases.safe_dosage: 50-60 ml per acre in 100 liters water
diseases.safety_precautions: Strictly observe 21-day pre-harvest interval (PHI) before cutting fodder or grain.

symptoms: diamond shaped lesions with grey center
diseases.recommended_treatment: Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer. Drain standing water temporarily and apply systemic fungicide.
diseases.safe_dosage: 100-120 grams per acre in 100 liters water
diseases.safety_precautions: Spray at tillering and boot stage. Highly toxic to fish.
diseases.source: Rice Research Institute Kala Shah Kaku & PlantVillage

diseases.disease_name: Rice Stem Borer (دھان کی تنے کی سنڈی)
diseases.recommended_treatment: Apply granular insecticide in standing water or light traps during moth emergence.
diseases.safe_dosage: 7-9 kg granules per acre broadcasted in 2-3 inches standing water
diseases.safety_precautions: Retain water in field for at least 4-5 days after application.

symptoms: greenish caterpillar with Y-shaped head mark
diseases.recommended_treatment: Hand-drop bio-pesticide or neem seed extract into central leaf whorl. If heavy infestation, directed whorl spray.
diseases.safe_chemical: Emamectin Benzoate 1.9 EC or Chlorantraniliprole 20 SC
diseases.safe_dosage: 75-80 ml per acre directed into leaf whorls in 120 liters water
diseases.safety_precautions: Nozzle must be pointed directly inside whorls. Avoid drift.

symptoms: white mold on leaf undersides during humid weather
diseases.recommended_treatment: Immediately cease irrigation. Apply protective or curative systemic fungicide before rain.
diseases.safe_chemical: Dimethomorph + Mancozeb 69 WP or Cymoxanil + Mancozeb
diseases.safe_dosage: 250-300 grams per acre in 100 liters water
diseases.safety_precautions: Repeat at 7-10 day intervals if cold humid weather persists. Wear full PPE.

diseases.disease_name: Early Blight & Leaf Curl (ٹماٹر کا جھلساؤ اور پتہ مروڑ)
diseases.recommended_treatment: Remove lower infected foliage. Ensure drip irrigation rather than overhead sprinkling.
diseases.safe_dosage: 200 grams per acre in 100 liters water
diseases.safety_precautions: Wash hands after handling. Do not harvest within 7 days of spray.
